01 · About

Learning by building, one prototype at a time.

I like turning ideas into something I can click, test or grow — not just read about.

I'm pursuing B.Tech Biotechnology at Lovely Professional University. Alongside coursework, I'm drawn to the intersection of biology and computing — working with Python, HTML, Excel and Power BI, and picking up the basics of UI/UX design.

Outside class, I've built hackathon projects in 24–48 hour sprints, volunteered with a community programme supporting children's education and welfare, and worked through self-paced certifications in Python, Excel and Power BI to build practical, hands-on skill.

02 · Featured Project

Aquaponics System — fish, plants & water.

Independent Project · 2026

Fish waste feeding plants, plants cleaning the water

A self-built aquaponics system combining fish farming and plant cultivation in a single sustainable setup — studying how the two sides support each other.

TypeIndependent build
FocusSustainability · Biology
SystemWater recirculation
OutcomeWorking prototype
01Designed a water recirculation loop so fish waste nourishes the plants while the plants help filter and clean the water.
02Selected fish and plants based on their growth requirements and compatibility within the shared system.
03Monitored water quality, pH, temperature, plant growth and fish health throughout the setup.
04Demonstrated aquaponics as a low-waste, resource-efficient way to grow food compared with conventional methods.
